_comment: Example Claude Code settings.json for repos you want Tokentrail to track. Copy this into <repo>/.claude/settings.json and set TOKENTRAIL_HOOK to the absolute path of tokentrail's session-end.sh script (e.g. /Users/you/Projects/tokentrail/src/hooks/session-end.sh). Claude Code will fire the Stop hook at session end, and the next `tokentrail ingest` run can merge those snapshots for sharper branch attribution.
